laneSummary: Both assigned defects were reproduced and repaired with focused current evidence. Both rows remain repair claims, not independent verdicts, and require fresh independent reads.
aboutTheNineCounters: The focused completeness reader reports all nine counters at zero for both existing family outputs. Those counters do not detect either assigned boundary-length defect and are recorded only as unchanged census state, not as repair evidence or a verdict.

rows.redEvidence: Before repair, both boundary CR-409 artifacts had 12 finalizerWritten rows instead of the canonical fixture's 14. TCCaseName and ProtectedEmail were absent from finalizerWritten and present in finalizerRefused with reason value_exceeds_widget_width_at_minimum_font.
rows.measuredRootCause: The exact boundary name and email require 195.6pt and 253.8pt at six points, while their CR-409 widgets provide only 172.38pt and 221.38pt of usable width. Trying the declared six-point minimum alone therefore cannot fit either value; both need a modest, measured horizontal scale as well as the six-point vertical size.
rows.codeRepairApplied: Added a ca-851-91-set-only 85-percent minimum horizontal-scale policy to the exact mapped-fact overlay. The fitter first tries every ordinary readable size unchanged; only a single-line width refusal may use six-point text with a measured Tz scale, and it still refuses if the required scale would fall below 85 percent. The shared fitter and every unrelated family retain their prior behavior.
rows.selfTestResult: SELF_TEST_OK: both exact CR-409 boundary strings refuse without the family opt-in, fit at measured horizontal scales of at least 85 percent with the opt-in, remain within their recorded widget widths, and a synthetic exact-mapped appearance preserves the complete boundary name in output PDF bytes.
rows.artifactAssertionResult: BUILD_OK and CHECK_OK: both boundary CR-409 variants now carry all 14 mapped writes, including the complete TCCaseName and ProtectedEmail values at measured horizontal scales above the 85-percent floor.

The focused regression assertion required 20 DefName widget font sizes and 7 DefAddrStr widget font sizes, each at least six points, and failed because DefName.widgetFontSizes was absent. rows.measuredRootCause: The disorderly-persons family did not opt into the shared host's per-widget fitting, so one size was applied across repeated widgets with different widths. The same family also mapped residence county into the filing-county control before its wrapper reclassified that control. The repair opts only this family into per-widget fitting, denies that mapping, and aligns the read-only checker with the build path.
